mission: Build reusable, concurrent, cumulative visual observation learning and a verified downstream consumption interface
work: New smart_video_learning.py batch orchestration, frozen initial observational priors and strictly bounded concurrent workers
Single shared learning-memory consolidation after all batch checkpoints, preserving history and avoiding intra-batch memory races
Public get_visual_features() read-only API with contest+timestamp cutoff and SHA256 source provenance
Immutable consumer study corpus with explicit observed motion timestamps, spatial/cadence metadata, source hashes, integrity checks and idempotent replay
Retain original smart_video_observation.py single-contest API and checkpoint format; permit suppressed per-contest memory writes only when batched
CLI --manifest / --target-contest with verified independent-process restart and consumption
